facts.fact: Hurricane Electric's press release describes iXAfrica NBOX1 on Mombasa Road, Nairobi, as a carrier-neutral data center serving cloud providers, hyperscalers and enterprises, where Hurricane Electric has opened a point of presence.

KEN.note: Names exchange points only worldwide; none in Kenya.
Mentions subsea access through Mombasa but names no cable or route in service.
iXAfrica's ownership and Tier are not stated.
No arrangement between African countries stated.
